mainEntity.name: Can functional fitness help with injury prevention or rehabilitation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, functional fitness can significantly aid in injury prevention and, under professional guidance, assist with rehabilitation. By strengthening the muscles used in everyday movements and improving overall stability, it helps correct imbalances and enhances the body's natural protective mechanisms. This type of training improves proprioception and joint stability, which are crucial for reducing the risk of strains and sprains. If you have an existing injury, always consult a medical professional before starting any new fitness regimen and inform your trainer so they can modify exercises appropriately.
